rules.title: Authentic logo on every page
rules.summary: Logo is the RDI master SVG, not the Payload CMS placeholder.

rules.title: Logo colourway matches background
rules.summary: Default Paper, Reverse Ink, Reverse Navy, or Reverse Signature — the background dictates which.

rules.title: Favicon is the RDI mark
rules.summary: public/favicon.svg is the RDI iris, not the template chevron.

rules.title: No red text
rules.summary: No text-rdi-accent, text-red-*, or inline red colors. Anywhere.

rules.title: Colors come from tokens
rules.summary: All colors via CSS variables. No bg-[#hex] or hardcoded inline.

rules.title: Error is distinct from Signature Red
rules.summary: Error styling uses #9A1014, not #C3161C.

rules.title: Dark mode tokens flip correctly
rules.summary: data-theme='dark' resolves to correct palette; no red text on dark surfaces.

rules.title: Inter + JetBrains Mono
rules.summary: Inter for body/headlines; Mono for numbers, IDs, dates, coordinates. No Geist.

rules.title: Brand type scale
rules.summary: Display 96 / H1 48 / H2 30 / H3 22 / Lead 20 / Body 16 / Small 13 / Eyebrow 11 / Mono 13.

rules.title: Numbers in Mono
rules.summary: Dates, IDs, percentages, coordinates, counts — all wrapped in font-mono.

rules.title: Main titles carry the red rule
rules.summary: Every section H1/H2 has a 64×3px red rule below it (18px gap).

rules.title: Eyebrow is plain Ink
rules.summary: No leading red bar, no red text. Uppercase Inter Bold 11px in Ink color.

rules.title: No duplicate uppercase title
rules.summary: Folio at top OR eyebrow above H2 — never both saying the same thing.

rules.title: Vertical rail on container, not title element
rules.summary: Rail belongs to the wrapper holding title + body, spanning the full block. Not on the H3 alone.

rules.title: Restraint — one red line per page
rules.summary: Don't multiply the rail across a list of items. H2 line is enough.

rules.title: Link underline
rules.summary: No default underline. On hover, 2.5ch red line animates left-to-right (200ms ease-out soft).

rules.title: Eyebrow uses Ink, not red
rules.summary: <Eyebrow> renders text-rdi-ink uppercase. The old text-rdi-accent must be replaced.

rules.title: SectionTitle exists and is used
rules.summary: Section main headings render via <SectionTitle> (H2 + red rule below), not bare H2.

rules.title: Button variants correct
rules.summary: Primary on Signature Red fill, Red Strong on hover. Ghost reveals 2px red bottom border on hover.

rules.title: Alerts use Ink text
rules.summary: Red border + Red Soft fill + Ink-color message text. Never red text in an alert.

rules.title: Cards reveal red left border on hover
rules.summary: Card hover shows a 3px red left border (the vertical red line interactive form).

rules.title: Lucide as the icon library
rules.summary: lucide-react for utility; bespoke RDI set for marketing (v1.3 deliverable).

rules.title: Active state uses red dot
rules.summary: State-bearing icons (active, focused, in-progress) carry a 6–8px red dot in upper-right. Not a triangle wedge.

rules.title: Real RDI site frames
rules.summary: Imagery comes from public/rdi/images/ or commissioned shoots. No stock libraries.

rules.title: No AI-generated construction imagery
rules.summary: Forbidden brand-wide. Real reality only.

rules.title: Annotations follow the rules
rules.summary: Mono timestamps; red wedge for focus; no other red elements on a photo.

rules.title: Observation first, claim second
rules.summary: Show the data, the frame, the timestamp — then make the claim.

rules.title: Numbers attributed and dated
rules.summary: Every figure carries a source and a timestamp. A figure without these is not a figure.

rules.title: Forbidden words avoided
rules.summary: No 'powerful,' 'seamless,' 'intelligent' as adjective, 'next-generation,' 'robust,' 'AI' without specifics.

rules.title: WCAG AA contrast
rules.summary: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large. No exceptions.

rules.title: Focus rings visible
rules.summary: Every interactive element shows a 2px Signature Red outline on focus.

rules.title: Tab order follows reading order
rules.summary: No keyboard traps. Tab progresses through the page logically.

rules.title: Decorative SVGs are aria-hidden
rules.summary: Red lines, icon wedges, dividers carry aria-hidden='true'.

rules.title: Reduced motion respected
rules.summary: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce honored on transitions > 200ms.

rules.title: No hardcoded color values
rules.summary: No bg-[#hex], no style={{ color: '...' }} for brand colors.

rules.title: ESLint forbids the no-red-text pattern
rules.summary: Rule rejects text-rdi-accent, text-red-*, inline red colors in .tsx files.

rules.title: Components forward className + ref
rules.summary: Component contract: accept className via clsx/tailwind-merge, forwardRef where wrapping a single DOM element.
